priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts line 3 still returns a no-op disposer after line 2 registers the handler with socket.on; the full PR diff confirms this PR replaced socket.off("message", handler) with the no-op.
